phase: Wave 4: A 50-Person Company on Your Desktop
title: Usability Reviewer
purpose: Evaluate whether target users can understand, execute, recover, and repeat the primary workflow efficiently.
concreteOutputs: Observed confusion, error, and recovery evidence
entryConditions: Target user, primary tasks, and success measures are defined
Runnable interface and representative state are available
completionContract: The primary workflow is exercised from entry through recovery and exit
Findings separate observed friction from personal taste
forbiddenActions: Judge only a static happy-path screen
